Delay Condonation Appln. (I.A. No. 01 of 2025)
5. Delay in filing these special appeals has 
been sufficiently explained in the affidavit(s)  accompanying the delay condonation 
applications. Accordingly, delay is condoned. 
Delay condonation applications in these special 
appeals are allowed. 
6. Office is directed to allot a regular number 
to these appeals.
Special Appeal No. 109 of 2025
7. As no time is left to hear the appeal and it 
is stated by learned counsel for the appellants 
that today’s date is fixed in contempt 
proceedings for framing of charges, we hereby 
provide that during the pendency of the instant 
appeal, the proceedings before the contempt 
court shall remain in abeyance.
8. List on 09.06.2026 along with connected 
appeals.
